nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: React hook that loads and manages Projects/Work-Items sidebar state, combining local project data with Linear-synced organizations, projects, and work items into grouped, ready-to-render menu structures.

nodes.name: useProjectsWorkItemMenuItems
nodes.summary: Loads local orgs/projects/work items and Linear orgs/work items on demand, tracks per-org load state, and builds grouped Projects sidebar menu sections (by org, project, status, priority).

nodes.name: linearHelpers.ts
nodes.summary: Small helpers for deriving Linear organization identifiers/names and normalizing Linear API errors and connection-shape checks.

nodes.name: menuRows.tsx
nodes.summary: Builder functions that construct individual sidebar menu-item rows (org headers, load-more rows, project rows, work-item rows) for the Projects/Work-Items navigation menu.

nodes.name: localOrgMenuRow
nodes.summary: Internal helper that assembles the base menu-item shape for a local organization header row.

nodes.name: linearOrgRow
nodes.summary: Builds the menu row for a Linear-synced organization header, keyed by its Linear org menu-item id.

nodes.name: groupLoadMoreRow
nodes.summary: Builds a 'load more' row appended to a group of project/work-item menu rows when more items are available.

nodes.name: linearLoadRow
nodes.summary: Builds the row prompting the user to load a Linear organization's projects/work items, reflecting an in-flight loading state.

nodes.name: createWorkItemRow
nodes.summary: Builds the 'create new work item' action row scoped to a given organization.

nodes.name: buildProjectOverviewRow
nodes.summary: Builds the menu row linking to a project's overview page, keyed by its project overview menu-item id.

nodes.name: pendingSyncIndicator
nodes.summary: Renders a small indicator element shown on a row when the project/work item has a pending collaboration sync.

nodes.name: buildProjectRow
nodes.summary: Builds a full project menu row including its overview link and pending-sync indicator.

nodes.name: buildWorkItemRow
nodes.summary: Builds a full work-item menu row with status icon, translated label, and pending-sync indicator, supporting both local and Linear work items.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for local/Linear projects, organizations, and work items used throughout the Projects sidebar menu feature.

nodes.name: workItemMapping.tsx
nodes.summary: Conversion and sorting helpers that normalize raw work-item status/priority values, render status icons, and group work items for sidebar display.

nodes.name: toWorkItemStatus
nodes.summary: Normalizes an arbitrary status string to a known WorkItemStatus, falling back to a default when unrecognized.

nodes.name: toWorkItemPriority
nodes.summary: Normalizes an arbitrary priority string to a known WorkItemPriority, falling back to a default when unrecognized.

nodes.name: statusIconElement
nodes.summary: Renders the status icon element for a work item based on its status configuration.

nodes.name: sortWorkItemsByActivity
nodes.summary: Sorts a list of work items by most-recent update/creation activity, descending.

nodes.name: pushGroupedItems
nodes.summary: Appends a work item into the correct bucket of a grouped-items map, creating the bucket if absent.

nodes.name: useRenameSessionModal.ts
nodes.summary: Hook managing the rename-session modal's visibility and input state, and persisting a renamed session via the session store and RPC layer.

nodes.name: useRenameSessionModal
nodes.summary: Opens the rename dialog for a given session id, tracks the editable name, and submits the rename via upsertSession plus an rpc.sessionAggregate.patch call.

nodes.name: useSessionMenuItems.tsx
nodes.summary: One-line barrel re-exporting the useSessionMenuItems hook implementation from the useSessionMenuItems/ subdirectory.

nodes.name: dateGroupingHelpers.ts
nodes.summary: Defines date-group bucket keys/defaults and a helper that classifies a session into a date group for the session list sidebar.

nodes.name: getDateGroup
nodes.summary: Returns the date-group bucket (e.g. today/this week/older) a session belongs to, delegating to getSessionDateBucket.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Primary hook assembling the session list sidebar: merges subagent child sessions, applies search/org filters, groups by time/agent/workspace, and produces paginated, load-more-aware menu items.

nodes.name: liveDetailForSession
nodes.summary: Extracts the live status detail for a session from an agent live-status map entry.

nodes.name: childRecordToSession
nodes.summary: Converts a raw child-session record fetched from the backend into a Session object linked to its parent session id.

nodes.name: buildChildSessionMenuItem
nodes.summary: Builds the indented menu-item row representing a subagent child session, using the shared session row builder.

nodes.name: insertExpandedSubagentRows
nodes.summary: Inlines child-session rows immediately after their parent session row for parents that are expanded in the sidebar tree.

nodes.name: useSessionMenuItems
nodes.summary: Central session-list hook: fetches benchmark/subagent child sessions, filters by visibility/search/org/exclusion rules, groups sessions by mode, and returns paginated menu items with load-more rows.

nodes.name: menuItemBuilders.tsx
nodes.summary: Helpers that classify session state (pending/completed/benchmark) and build the visual sidebar menu item for a single session row.

nodes.name: isSessionCompletedUnread
nodes.summary: Determines whether a completed session has an unread result that should be visually flagged.

nodes.name: buildSessionMenuItem
nodes.summary: Builds the full sidebar menu-item row for a session, including status dot, label, and unread/benchmark styling.

nodes.name: menuSectionBuilders.ts
nodes.summary: Builds grouped sidebar menu sections for sessions organized by time bucket, coding agent, or workspace, inserting separators and load-more rows as needed.

nodes.name: buildByTimeMenuItems
nodes.summary: Groups sessions into date buckets (today/this week/older, etc.) and emits section separators between them.

nodes.name: buildByAgentMenuItems
nodes.summary: Groups sessions by their coding agent, mapping each group key to the wire-format category and inserting section separators.

nodes.name: buildByWorkspaceMenuItems
nodes.summary: Groups sessions by their originating workspace/repo, producing labeled sections with separators.

nodes.name: orgFilter.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the set of organization ids to filter sessions by and checks whether a session matches the active org filter/scope.

nodes.name: buildSessionOrgFilterIds
nodes.summary: Derives the set of organization ids that should be used to filter the session list, based on cloud org scope selection.

nodes.name: sessionMatchesOrgFilter
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given session belongs to one of the currently selected organizations.

nodes.name: paginationHelpers.tsx
nodes.summary: Load-more row builders and pagination-state helpers (unified and per-group) driving incremental reveal of sessions in the sidebar.

nodes.name: loadMoreRow
nodes.summary: Builds a single category's 'load more' row for the session list.

nodes.name: groupLoadMoreRow
nodes.summary: Builds a 'load more' row scoped to a specific session group within a section.

nodes.name: unifiedLoadMoreRow
nodes.summary: Builds the single combined 'load more' row shown when the session list uses unified (non-grouped) pagination.

nodes.name: getUnifiedLoadMoreState
nodes.summary: Computes the aggregate loading/has-more state across all pagination categories for the unified load-more row.

nodes.name: loadUnifiedReadyCategories
nodes.summary: Selects which pagination categories are ready to be advanced together under unified load-more.

nodes.name: appendSessionGroup
nodes.summary: Appends a session group's visible items (and its load-more row, if applicable) onto the running menu-items list.

nodes.name: sessionGroupHelpers.ts
nodes.summary: Maps an internal session group key to the wire-format category string used by session pagination APIs.

nodes.name: groupKeyToWireCategory
nodes.summary: Converts an internal by-agent group key into the wire-format pagination category string.

nodes.name: statusIndicators.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders animated 'breathing' and static status dot indicators used to show session activity state in the sidebar.

nodes.name: renderBreathingStatusDot
nodes.summary: Renders an animated pulsing status dot used to indicate an actively-running session.

nodes.name: renderStatusDot
nodes.summary: Renders the appropriate static or animated status dot for a session based on its current status.
